dialogues.speaker: Ixcatl
dialogues.text: Ahh, I couldn't stop it! I let it get away! I knew I should have trained harder... Next time the Pilgrimage of the Return of the Sacred Flame comes around, I'll have to do better than this!

dialogues.speaker: Ixcatl
dialogues.text: Ahh, I couldn't stop it! I let it get away! I knew I should have trained harder... I must do better than this the next time I encounter Abyssal creatures!

dialogues.speaker: Ixcatl
dialogues.text: That's right. I was on my way to train when I ran into a rampaging Tatankasaurus. I tried my best to stop it...

dialogues.speaker: Ixcatl
dialogues.text: But take a look — it smashed right into this fence. In the end, it ran off up the mountain... I can see I need to train more!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The Pilgrimage of the Return of the Sacred Flame?

dialogues.speaker: Ixcatl
dialogues.text: Huh? Are you a visitor from afar?

dialogues.speaker: Ixcatl
dialogues.text: The Pilgrimage is a competition that represents the highest honor to us Natlanese. Only the mightiest warriors stand a chance of attaining ultimate victory!

dialogues.speaker: Ixcatl
dialogues.text: Haha, I'm a little embarrassed to say this, but I didn't expect to be matched against Coach Iansan when I signed up.

dialogues.speaker: Ixcatl
dialogues.text: Even Varesa, the strongest wrestler on our team, was trounced by her — but that's Coach "Power" Iansan for you.

dialogues.speaker: Ixcatl
dialogues.text: Still, I'm determined to train as hard as I can! That way, I won't lose to anyone — except the Coach, anyway!

dialogues.speaker: Ixcatl
dialogues.text: Thanks for the encouragement, friend! I hope your journey brings you nothing but victory!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the battles that happened previously...

dialogues.speaker: Ixcatl
dialogues.text: The Collective of Plenty wasn't the main focus of the Abyss's attacks this time and we made it through the battle relatively unscathed.

dialogues.speaker: Ixcatl
dialogues.text: Nevertheless... Some of our warriors were still embraced by the peace of eternal night.

dialogues.speaker: Ixcatl
dialogues.text: They defended their glory with strength and safeguarded the freedom of others. That is the greatest ending for any warrior.

dialogues.speaker: Ixcatl
dialogues.text: Thanks for the encouragement, friend! I hope your journey brings you nothing but victory!
